mapper.sql: p.*, sl.layer_name, sl.shelf_code, br.status AS borrow_status, br.borrower, br.production_line, br.checkout_time AS checkout_time_borrow, br.expected_return_time AS expected_return_time_borrow, CASE WHEN br.status = 'BORROWED' AND br.expected_return_time IS NOT NULL AND br.expected_return_time < NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS borrow_overdue, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pad_maintenance_record mr WHERE mr.pad_id = p.id AND mr.maintenance_result = 'SCRAPPED') AS scrap_suggested, (SELECT r.id FROM pad_mold_reserve_record r INNER JOIN pad_mold_reserve_item ri ON ri.reserve_id = r.id WHERE ri.pad_id = p.id AND r.status IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE') AND r.end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY r.start_time DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS reserve_id, (SELECT r.mold_code FROM pad_mold_reserve_record r INNER JOIN pad_mold_reserve_item ri ON ri.reserve_id = r.id WHERE ri.pad_id = p.id AND r.status IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE') AND r.end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY r.start_time DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS reserve_mold_code
mapper.select: SELECT FROM pad_info p LEFT JOIN shelf_layer sl ON p.shelf_layer_code = sl.layer_code LEFT JOIN pad_borrow_record br ON br.pad_id = p.id AND br.status = 'BORROWED' WHERE p.shelf_layer_code = #{layerCode} ORDER BY p.pad_code ASC

SELECT FROM pad_info p INNER JOIN shelf_layer sl ON p.shelf_layer_code = sl.layer_code LEFT JOIN pad_borrow_record br ON br.pad_id = p.id AND br.status = 'BORROWED' WHERE sl.shelf_code = #{shelfCode} ORDER BY sl.layer_code ASC, p.pad_code ASC
SELECT FROM pad_info p LEFT JOIN shelf_layer sl ON p.shelf_layer_code = sl.layer_code LEFT JOIN pad_borrow_record br ON br.pad_id = p.id AND br.status = 'BORROWED' WHERE p.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
